facts.fact: Semrush reporting, cited by Impact, found that articles of 3,000+ words generated 21% more traffic than average-length articles of 901 to 1,200 words.
facts.quote: generated 21% more traffic, 24% more shares, and 75% more backlinks

facts.fact: The article was published on June 15, 2026.
A 2026 Semrush Authority Report, as cited by Adwave through a third-party summary, said long-form content averaging 2,500 words generated 63% more backlinks than content under 1,000 words.
facts.quote: long-form content averaging 2,500 words generated **63% more backlinks** than content under 1,000 words

facts.fact: According to the same Semrush Authority Report as cited by Adwave, the backlink advantage of long-form content averaging 2,500 words over content under 1,000 words was 56% in the prior year.
